cves.title: PHP-CGI argument injection on Windows lets an attacker run code
cves.fix: Upgrade PHP to 8.1.29, 8.2.20 or 8.3.8, or stop running PHP in CGI mode on Windows.

cves.title: OpenSSH regreSSHion: a race condition in sshd lets an attacker run code remotely
nginx ngx_http_mp4_module: a crafted file can crash a worker process
cves.fix: Upgrade nginx to 1.26.2 or 1.27.1, or switch the mp4 module off.

alerts.title: SQL injection (UNION SELECT) in 1 request
alerts.detail: A request carried an attack payload. If the site answered normally, check that the input is handled safely.

alerts.title: Password guessing: 14 failed sign-ins from 1 address
alerts.detail: Someone is trying passwords against your sign-in. Block the addresses below and make sure the accounts they hit use strong passwords and a second step.
